verdict.rationale: Fastmail's own Filters & Rules feature is the only first-party automation in the pack, and server-side mail rules plausibly run unattended, but the evidence is just the help-article title with no detail on triggers, actions or background execution. Scheduled Send and Snooze are one-off timed actions, not recurring automations, and the JMAP API, tokens and push are developer building blocks, so none of these earn credit. Missing for 10: documented content on what rules can do and how they run, recurring or scheduled automations, agent-style autonomous workflows, and independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background
